description: Test class for UserService in the book project, utilizing Mockito and JUnit 5 to verify behaviors and interactions of UserService methods.

classes.name: UserServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the UserService, testing various methods including registration, retrieval, update, deletion, and lock mechanisms.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the UserService instance with mocked dependencies before each test.

methods.name: register_throwsNullPointerException_ifUserIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that registering a null user throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: findUserById_searchesRepository
methods.description: Confirms that findUserById calls the repository's findById method.

methods.name: findUserById_throwsNullPointerException_ifIdIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that passing null as ID to findUserById throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: findUserByEmail_searchesRepository
methods.description: Verifies that findUserByEmail invokes the repository's findByEmail method.

methods.name: findUserByEmail_throwsNullPointerException_ifEmailIsNull
methods.description: Checks that null email input results in NullPointerException.

methods.name: isEmailInUse_throwsNullPointerException_ifEmailIsNull
methods.description: Confirms that passing null email to isEmailInUse throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: returnTrueIfEmailInUse
methods.description: Tests that isEmailInUse returns true if email is found in repository.

methods.name: returnFalseIfEmailInUse
methods.description: Tests that isEmailInUse returns false if email is not found.

methods.name: changeUserEmail_throwsIncorrectPasswordException_ifPasswordIncorrect
methods.description: Verifies that incorrect password during email change throws IncorrectPasswordException.

methods.name: changeUserEmail_throwsUserAlreadyRegisteredException_ifPasswordIncorrect
methods.description: Checks that attempting to change email to the same current email throws UserAlreadyRegisteredException.

methods.name: changeUserPassword_throwsNullPointerException_ifUserIsNull
methods.description: Verifies NullPointerException if user is null during password change.

methods.name: changeUserPassword_throwsNullPointerException_ifPasswordIsNull
methods.description: Checks that null password during change throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: changeUserPassword_encodesPassword_beforeSaving
methods.description: Ensures that the password is encoded before saving the user.

methods.name: deleteUserById_deletesUser_ifUserExists
methods.description: Verifies user deletion and repository interactions when user exists.

methods.name: deleteUserById_throwsNotFound_IfUserDoesNotExist
methods.description: Ensures that trying to delete a non-existing user throws ResponseStatusException.

methods.name: lock_setsToTrue_andSetsLockTime
methods.description: Verifies that locking a user sets locked status and lock time.
